entry.title: Bamburgh Castle

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 equals standard viewer DEM41.1229m at the mapped anchor. Inner courtY6.5m and western slope/gate/windmill attachments are photo-led estimates; coarse DEM is not a measured bare-earth surface.

entry.note: Exact-QID enclosure plus individual PMTiles plans and two opposite oblique photographs establish approximate scale and signed facing. Heights, terraces, gateways and terrain joins remain exterior estimates. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
